From the Library build thread ([[library-hall-build]], 16 Oct 2026, X_ITE 16.5.0): each GaussianSplats node holds the scene's loading state until its first sort, and a frustum-culled node is never sorted, so loadURL hangs
Fix there: give every node a whole-subset bboxSize and bboxCenter (make_presets_walk.py --cull-off).
